I confirmed that exactly 3 enterprise accounts have integrations that cannot be changed by their application teams without guided migration sessions. Each of these accounts needs weekly migration office hours during the transition. I haven't added this support requirement to the deprecation ticket yet because the renewal review is still being reconciled, but this is a real readiness concern that affects the July 1 timeline.
